recipe: cp qemu-x86_64.config .config && make olddefconfig && make -j$(nproc) bzImage
notes: Built for the QEMU amd64 pc machine. CONFIG_ACPI=y (QEMU pc requires ACPI for PCI IRQ routing; Firecracker sets it off). Uses make bzImage (compressed x86 kernel that QEMU -kernel loads directly) instead of the Firecracker vmlinux, which QEMU rejects without a PVH ELF note. Not hermetic: built on Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64 with distro toolchain; the vendored blob is the authoritative artifact.
